summary: Continuously answers "what am I looking at" and fires an event when the answer changes.
overview: Raycasts from the screen centre, crosshair style, or straight out of this transform, and fires OnTargetChanged whenever what it finds changes. Distinct from a hitscan attack, which is a one-shot "fire now" rather than a standing query.
useCases: A "Press E to interact" prompt that appears when you look at something.
Highlighting whatever is under the crosshair.
Enemy or object tooltips in a first-person view.

params.tuning: On for a first or third-person crosshair. Off to raycast from the object's own forward, for an NPC's gaze or a turret.
Narrow this, or the world geometry behind your target becomes the target.

gotchas.title: It raycasts every frame
gotchas.body: One raycast is cheap; one per frame per finder across many objects is not. Give NPC gaze checks an interval rather than running this on everything.
